findCategory.context: Add screen (laptop layout): placeholder of the search field above the category tiles.

findCategoryLabel.message: Znajdź kategorię, Enter wybiera pierwszą pasującą
findCategoryLabel.context: Add screen (laptop): accessible label of the category search; pressing Enter selects the first result.

noMatch.context: Add screen (laptop): no category matches the typed search {query}.

goals.context: Add screen: heading of the savings goals that can be spent from (a tile, and a heading in search results).

spend.context: Add screen: the Goals tile's main line; tapping it lets you log an expense paid from a savings goal. Very short (fits a small tile).

count.context: Add screen: small line on the Goals tile, e.g. '3 goals · from savings'. Very short.

title.context: Add screen > bottom sheet heading: pick which savings goal an expense is paid from.

help.message: Płacone z oszczędności: schodzi z konta, na którym leżą pieniądze celu, a nie z budżetu miesiąca.
help.context: Add screen > 'Spent from a goal' sheet: explanation under the heading.

spentOf.context: Add screen > 'Spent from a goal' sheet: under a goal's name, how much of its target has been spent. {currency} is 'zł'.

spent.context: Add screen > 'Spent from a goal' sheet: under a goal without a target, how much has been spent. {currency} is 'zł'.

recentEmpty.message: W tym miesiącu jeszcze nic nie zapisano.
recentEmpty.context: Add screen (laptop): the Recent list when nothing has been logged this month.

widgetSlide.context: Accessible label of one widget card in the swipeable carousel on the Add screen, e.g. 'Pace, 2 of 8'.

thisMonth.context: Add screen (laptop): line under the heading, total spent this month; keep the <b> tags around {amount}.

loadFailed.context: Add screen: error when categories fail to load; {error} is a technical message.

categories.context: Add screen (laptop): accessible label of the category tiles section.

newEntry.context: Add screen (laptop): accessible label of the panel where a new expense or income is typed.

pickFirst.context: Add screen (laptop): hint in the entry panel before a category is chosen.

keys.context: Add screen (laptop): keyboard hint under the save button. Keep the <kbd> tags; key names are usually left untranslated.

recent.context: Add screen (laptop, wide): heading of the list of the last entries.

perDayLeft.context: Add screen (laptop): what can be spent per day for the rest of the month.
